commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
90+5' Alvaro Fernandez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) after a cross from the side.
90+4' A cross from Ruben Pena (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+4' A precise short pass from Aimar Oroz releases Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
90+2' The Osasuna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Kike Salas (Sevilla) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
88' A cross is whipped into the box by Suso (Sevilla) and Saul Niguez controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
88' The resulting corner from Suso (Sevilla) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
87' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) whips the ball into the box and Dodi Lukebakio takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Sevilla earn a corner.
86' Substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga makes way for Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
86' Here is a change. Jose Angel Carmona is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
85' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle as Loic Bade (Sevilla) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
83' Vicente Moreno is forced to make a change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz is unable to continue due to injury, Ruben Pena (Osasuna) comes on.
83' A substitution has been made. Juan Cruz goes off and Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) comes on.
82' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
81' The cross into the penalty area from Suso (Sevilla) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
80' Yellow card. Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
78' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Bryan Zaragoza.
77' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

75' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.

70' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Garcia.

69' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Jesus Areso sends a long raking pass onto the head of Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
67' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kike Salas (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
66' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Peque will be replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).

63' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
63' A long ball forward to Peque (Sevilla) is intercepted.
62' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
61' Juan Martinez Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
58' What a save from Sergio Herrera! Loic Bade (Sevilla) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
58' A quickly taken corner by Sevilla.
58' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Peque (Sevilla).

50' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

44' Close! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.

31' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
30' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

30' Wonderful pass from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) for Djibril Sow, but they can't profit from it as Sergio Herrera comes off his line to collect. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
29' Peque (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
27' The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
27' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

27' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
24' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) gets on the end of a cross from Isaac Romero, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the left post.
23' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
21' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
20' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Osasuna take a short corner kick.

18' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Alvaro Fernandez. The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

15' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
14' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) probably handled the ball.

10' Peque (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
7' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Fernandez intercepts the ball.
4' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) attempts to find Isaac Romero, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

3' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Martinez Munuera no option but to blow his whistle. Free kick. Sevilla will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
